operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1. The administration of American Samoa is hereby transferred from the Secretary of the Navy to the Secretary of the Interior, such transfer to become effective on July 1, 1951.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 2. The Department of the Navy and the Department of the Interior shall proceed with the plans for the transfer of administration of American Samoa as embodied in the above-mentioned memorandum of understanding between the two departments.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 2

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 3. When the transfer of administration made by this order becomes effective, the Secretary of the Interior shall take such action as may be necessary and appropriate, and in harmony with applicable law, for the administration of civil government in American Samoa.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 4. The executive departments and agencies of the Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Departments of the Navy and Interior in the effectuation of the provisions of this order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 4

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 5. The said Executive order of February 19, 1900, is revoked, effective July 1, 1951.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); para. 5
